title: Console tooling sync digest — week of 2026-03-15
content:
Attendees: Marissa (PM lead), Evan, Diego, Priya, Sana, Mateo (guest from product)

Purpose: condensed weekly sync for Console & Tooling — capture progress across UI polish, rollout infra, analytics pipeline, outstanding risks, and next-step owners. This is intentionally terse; see linked tickets for deep context.

This week highlights (quick TL;DR):
- UI: final pass on responsive header + keyboard navigation landed behind feature flag; visual regression surfaced on Safari (macOS 13) — small CSS edge case. UX accepted quick patch required.
- Rollouts: canary routing MVP deployed to staging; automatic fallback logic prototype validated on synthetic traffic. Need production runbook and SLA test plan.
- Analytics: event schema v2 deployed to ingestion; we found ~2% of events missing user_id due to legacy mobile client — triage in-flight.

Completed since last sync:
- Console header keyboard nav (WIP -> feature-flagged): PR 412 merged to staging (Evan). QA checklist completed except Safari font-metric issue.
- Canary router: routing policy selector added + metrics emitted (Diego). End to end tests added to CI but still flaky under concurrency.
- Cost breakdown dashboard: first draft panels wired to new v2 events (Priya). Basic filters and per-route token counts available.

In progress / blockers (by area):
- UI (Marissa / Evan)
  - Blocker: Safari rendering shift when using system fonts; reproducible with long org names. Short-term: force font fallback for header only (Evan to ship hotfix RDW-2418).
  - Accessibility pass scheduled for 3/18; keyboard focus outline needs design review (Sana owning follow-up).

- Rollouts infra (Diego / Mateo)
  - Blocker: CI concurrency test flakiness causes false negatives for canary promotion. Hypothesis: client-side retry bursts are overwhelming the staging pool. Action: add client-side jitter and increase staging pool for the test run (Diego).
  - Documentation gap: no runbook for manual rollback. Mateo to draft suggested steps and post to Confluence.

- Analytics (Priya)
  - Issue: ~2% of ingestion events missing user_id from legacy mobile SDK. Impact: small distortion in per-user metrics; larger for low-volume customers.
  - Workaround: enrich on ingestion with hashed device id until clients can be upgraded. Priya to coordinate with mobile SDK team (ticket RDW-2391).

Cross-cutting risks & notes:
- Canary promotion path must be resilient to partial model routing (hosted/dedicated/private differences). If routing falls back to model-variant with different tokenization, downstream metrics will be inconsistent — add token_model tag to events for traceability.
- SLAs for Dedicated customers require deterministic latency windows for rollouts. Need to confirm SLOs with SRE before enabling automatic promotion.

Decisions made this week:
- Hold off enabling auto-promote in production until (a) CI flakiness < 1% and (b) runbook + rollback steps published. Rationale: avoid noisy promotions causing customer-facing regressions.
- Add token_model and route_variant to analytics v2 schema (Priya to update Confluence schema page).

Action items (owner — ETA):
- Evan: ship Safari header hotfix (RDW-2418) and open follow-up PR for font metrics — ETA 2026-03-16.
- Sana: coordinate accessibility review and produce quick checklist for keyboard nav — ETA 2026-03-18.
- Diego: stabilize CI concurrency tests by adding client jitter + increase staging pool for next run — ETA 2026-03-17.
- Mateo: draft rollout rollback runbook in Confluence and circulate for review — ETA 2026-03-19.
- Priya: implement ingestion enrichment for legacy mobile events and track RDW-2391 with mobile SDK team — ETA 2026-03-20.
- Marissa: schedule cross-team tabletop for SLA/promote logic with SRE + Product — ETA 2026-03-18.

Open questions / parking lot:
- Should we surface a "rollback history" panel in Console for recent promotions? (low effort, medium value) — add to backlog if runbook accepted.
- How granular should token_model tags be (model family vs quantization level)? Priya & Marissa to propose a minimal viable tag set.

Notes to self (informal):
- Remember to record the canary run with an annotated trace (use production-like traffic generator) so we can reproduce timing issues in CI.
- Consider adding synthetic customers with low volume to our test fleet to catch analytics edge cases early.

Meeting cadence reminder: same time next week (Mon 10:30am PT). If anything pops before then ping #console-team on Slack. Attachments: links to PR 412, RDW-2391, RDW-2418 in linked artifacts.

End of digest.
